cases.strong: periodic [0,16,1,17]; context-specific successor is deterministic after startup
cases.weak: periodic [0,16,1,16,0,17,1,17]; one context has two successors
cases.absent: frozen xorshift/multiply byte generator in driver

inputs.materialization: Run `generate CASE OUTPUT` once before any measured encode and record SHA-256. The expected hashes are intentionally absent until that pre-measurement materialization receipt; no input is selected by filename.

operations: Exactly one encode and one fresh driver-process decode per CASE x VARIANT configuration. Malformed rejection checks do not create a replacement measurement row.
promotion: A context mode must beat global in complete CIXCTX1 bytes on strong and fresh-restore exactly. Weak and absent results, all side information, and malformed rejections are retained. No production selector or archive-format promotion follows this screen.
